column1: # Hand-curated mappings, verified by comparing artwork. These take
# precedence over all automatic matching stages.
# XSI "direction-left/right" describe the arrow direction; Papirus names the
# same icons by text flow ("ltr" arrow points right, "rtl" arrow points
# left). Verified by rendering both sets side by side.

# names are used in different UIs (software categories vs hardware).
